components.text: Sign in to Flagsmith and choose the organisation you want to connect. This integration covers the hosted Management API at api.flagsmith.com and 54 provider-tagged Management operations. Self-hosted deployments use a different API URL and are outside this integration. An SDK Environment Key is public and only reads flags; it cannot connect this Management API setup.

In Organisation Settings, open API Access and create an API key for this connection. On Enterprise or Scale-Up, select only the roles your work needs; otherwise the token may have full organisation administration access. Copy the token and paste it into the protected field below. Never use a public client-side Environment Key here or put the secret token in client code or a shared manifest.
Create and scope an API token

Test sends one read-only GET /api/v1/organisations/ with Authorization: Api-Key and verifies that the organisation-scoped token can list its one organisation. Ragentic discards the response. This confirms listing access only; other operations depend on your token's permissions. Save an encrypted credential and connector for your workspace. After rotating the token in Flagsmith, replace the saved credential from Manage credentials and test again.
Independent integration for Flagsmith Management API. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Flagsmith.
